newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan bourse firm on week, up 40 percent in '97.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan bourse firm on week, up 40 percent in '97.

text.p: The Abidjan stock exchange rose again in the week to Friday and now stands 39.88 percent higher than at the start of the year, according to the official bourse report.
The all-share BVA index added 1.09 percent in the latest week to end at 500.48.

Rubber company SOGB, which added 1,840 CFA last week, rose a further 990 to 20,830 CFA francs this week. It accounted for 62 percent of the total bourse volume of 266.9 million CFA francs during the week.
Another rubber company, SAPH, rose 650 to 13,650 and bank BICICI added 3,770 to 40,660.
Among declining issues, packaging firm SIEM fell 500 CFA francs to 29,500. Another block trade related to employee share purchases contributed to volume of 1.3 million CFA francs
